text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Interior minister says Kuwait respects human rights.
- Kuwait sends humanitarian aid to Sierra Leone.
- Fan fires a rocket-propelled grenagde to celebrate Kuwait's soccer victory. In the Middle East people often express happiness by firing weapons.
- Volume on Kuwait Stock Exchange falls, index rises.

- Jordan's prime minister receives message from Kuwaiti foreign minister. Ties between the two Arab states were strained during the 1990-91 Iraqi occupation of Kuwait when Amman appeared to sympathise with Baghdad.
